test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options that when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31a78efaff8666661bed3c3c8de61696bb3617df268299e2518af836eb5e4dfe.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The whole element rotate 90º clockwise subsequently.

2) The 3/4th circle element is alternately shaded.

3) One square element is alternately eliminated.

4) Another square element is alternately shaded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5adbe1456a0e6550ed7403859254ed809deb817742efffecef728336a065f70.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ff8bab91e01a4a706f8b9bffd9c06641334109f0778d5209deb1f211575e586.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
